_meta.note: Ascension variants are stored in fields prefixed with the ascension level (e.g. a8_hp, a9_moves). Prefixed move lists are FULL replacement lists, not diffs. In the Hive, HP scales at A8; attack damage, hit counts and Strength gains scale at A9. Block is mixed and must be read per-enemy: Tunneler (Burrow), Louse Progenitor (Curl Up / Curl and Grow), Slumbering Beetle (Plating) and Infested Prism (Pulsate) scale Block at A8 — these enemies therefore carry BOTH a8_moves and a9_moves, and their a9_moves lists already include the A8 Block value. Bowlbug (Egg)'s Bite Block, The Obscura's Hardening Strike Block and Infested Prism's Radiate Block scale at A9 instead. Crusher's Guarded Strike Block (18) and Enlarging Strike (4 dmg) have no ascension scaling at all. All numbers are taken from Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Hive, Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Elites and Module:Enemies/StS2_data/Bosses; where a rendered page disagreed with a module on the ascension level, the module was used.

powers: Imbalanced — becomes Stunned when its attack is fully blocked
Bowlbug (Rock).pattern: Uses Headbutt every turn. If Headbutt's damage is fully prevented it becomes Stunned and uses Dizzy on its next turn, then resumes Headbutt; any source of damage prevention counts.

Bowlbug (Nectar).pattern: Opens with Thrash, then uses Buff once, then uses Thrash every turn after.

powers: Hard to Kill 9 — reduces all damage taken and HP lost by it to 9
Exoskeleton.pattern: Openers are fixed by position: the first uses Skitter, the second Mandibles, the third Enrage, and the fourth (if present) randomly picks Skitter or Mandibles. After that: after Skitter the next move is randomly Skitter or Mandibles (it cannot repeat the same move twice in a row); after Mandibles it always uses Enrage; after Enrage the next move is randomly Skitter or Mandibles.

powers: Escape Artist 5 — tries to escape the combat after 5 turns
moves: Thievery — 17 dmg + steals a card from your deck
Flutter — gains Flutter (receives 50% less damage from Attacks; must be dealt attack damage 5 times to Stun it)
Escape — flees the combat, taking any stolen cards with it
a9_moves: Thievery — 19 dmg + steals a card from your deck
Flutter — gains Flutter (receives 50% less damage from Attacks; must be dealt attack damage 5 times to Stun it)
Escape — flees the combat, taking any stolen cards with it
Thieving Hopper.pattern: Fixed sequence Thievery → Flutter → Hat Trick → Nab → Escape. Cards stolen are lost permanently if it escapes and are returned if it is killed first. Steal priority: Uncommon cards first, then Rare/Common/Event, then Basic/Quest, then Ancient or Imbued, then Curses; Token and Status cards cannot be stolen.

moves: Burrow — gains Burrowed and 32 Block (Burrowed: its Block is not removed at the start of its turn; it is Stunned if all of its Block is removed)
a8_moves: Burrow — gains Burrowed and 37 Block (Burrowed: its Block is not removed at the start of its turn; it is Stunned if all of its Block is removed)
a9_moves: Burrow — gains Burrowed and 37 Block (Burrowed: its Block is not removed at the start of its turn; it is Stunned if all of its Block is removed)
Tunneler.pattern: Opens with Bite, then uses Burrow. While Burrowed it uses Attack from Below every turn. If its Block is fully removed while burrowed it uses Emerging Strike, then starts the cycle over with Bite.

powers: Artifact 2 — negates the next 2 debuffs applied to it
moves: Screech — shuffles 3 Dazed into your discard pile
a9_moves: Screech — shuffles 3 Dazed into your discard pile
Chomper.pattern: One Chomper opens with Clamp and the other with Screech; after that each alternates Clamp ↔ Screech every turn.

moves: Tenderizing Goop — applies 1 Tender (whenever you play a card, lose 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity this turn)
a9_moves: Tenderizing Goop — applies 1 Tender (whenever you play a card, lose 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity this turn)
Hunter Killer.pattern: Opens with Tenderizing Goop. Every turn after it picks randomly between Bite and Puncture with Puncture twice as likely, and Bite cannot be used twice in a row. Tender's Strength/Dexterity loss is applied after the played card's effects resolve, so a card's displayed damage is accurate at the moment it is played; when a card triggers other card plays, the loss is not applied until all triggered cards have finished resolving.

powers: Curl Up 14 (18 at A8) — gains that much Block upon first being hit
moves: Curl and Grow — gains 14 Block and 5 Strength
a8_moves: Curl and Grow — gains 18 Block and 5 Strength
a9_moves: Curl and Grow — gains 18 Block and 5 Strength
Louse Progenitor.pattern: Fixed cycle Web Cannon → Curl and Grow → Pounce, repeating.

moves: Toxic Cornucopia — adds 2 Toxic to your hand (Toxic is a 1-cost Status card: at the end of your turn, if it is in your hand, take 5 damage, then Exhaust)
a9_moves: Toxic Cornucopia — adds 2 Toxic to your hand (Toxic is a 1-cost Status card: at the end of your turn, if it is in your hand, take 5 damage, then Exhaust)
Myte.pattern: One Myte opens with Toxic Cornucopia and the other with Suck; both then follow the repeating cycle Toxic Cornucopia → Bite → Suck.

Ovicopter.pattern: Always opens with Lay Eggs, then Smash, then Tenderizer. After Tenderizer it checks its ally count: with 3 or fewer allies it uses Lay Eggs again, otherwise Nutritional Paste. It then resumes Smash → Tenderizer and repeats the check.

powers: Hatch — hatches after a set number of turns
Minion — minions abandon combat without their leader
moves: Hatch — becomes a Hatchling with 19-22 HP, removing all of its powers except Minion
a8_moves: Hatch — becomes a Hatchling with 20-23 HP, removing all of its powers except Minion
a9_moves: Hatch — becomes a Hatchling with 20-23 HP, removing all of its powers except Minion
Tough Egg.pattern: Does nothing while its Hatch counter runs down. The counter starts at 2 if the egg was summoned during the enemy's turn, or 1 if it was summoned during the player's turn. It then uses Hatch to become a Hatchling and uses Nibble every turn after.

powers: Minion — minions abandon combat without their leader
Hatchling.pattern: Uses Nibble every turn. Enters play at full HP when a Tough Egg hatches, carrying over none of the egg's powers except Minion.

powers: Plating 15 (18 at A8) — at the end of your turn it gains that much Block; Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn
Slumber 3 — awakens upon taking turns or losing HP 3 times
Slumbering Beetle.pattern: Starts asleep and uses Snore while Slumber lasts. Slumber counts down on turns it takes and on times it loses HP; when it expires the beetle wakes, loses its Plating entirely, and uses Roll Out every turn after.

Spiny Toad.pattern: Fixed cycle Protruding Spikes → Spike Explosion → Tongue Lash, repeating.

The Obscura.pattern: Always opens with Illusion on turn 1 to summon a Parafright. After that it randomly picks one of Piercing Gaze, Wail or Hardening Strike, and cannot use the same move twice in a row.

Parafright.summoned_by: The Obscura (1, via Illusion on turn 1)
powers: Illusion — when this dies, it revives next turn at full HP
Strength 6
Plating 6 — at the end of your turn it gains 6 Block; Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn
Mysterious Knight.pattern: Opens with Ram. Every turn after it picks randomly with Breaker at single weight and Flail and Ram at double weight each, and cannot use the same move twice in a row. Does not appear in the Hive encounter pools — it is fought in the Act 2 event 'The Lantern Key'.

powers: Reattach 25 — if other segments are still alive, revives in 2 turns with 25 HP
moves: Reattach — revives with 25 HP if other segments are alive
a9_moves: Reattach — revives with 25 HP if other segments are alive
Decimillipede.pattern: Each segment cycles Bulk → Writhe → Outgas in fixed order and starts at a different point in the cycle, running independently of the others. A killed segment revives 2 turns later with 25 HP so long as at least one other segment is still alive.

powers: Personal Hive 1 — whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add that many Dazed into your draw pile
moves: Pheromone Spit — gains 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength; if Personal Hive is already at 3, gains 2 Strength instead
a9_moves: Pheromone Spit — gains 1 Personal Hive and 1 Strength; if Personal Hive is already at 3, gains 2 Strength instead
Entomancer.pattern: Fixed cycle Beeeees! → Spear! → Pheromone Spit, repeating. Personal Hive triggers when the Entomancer takes attack damage, not when an Attack is played. Solo encounter with no summons.

powers: Vital Spark 2 (3 at A9) — all Skills are Tainted 2 (Tainted X: take X additional damage from Attacks this turn)
moves: Pulsate — 8 dmg + gains 20 Block and 2 Vital Spark
a8_moves: Pulsate — 8 dmg + gains 22 Block and 2 Vital Spark
a9_moves: Pulsate — 10 dmg + gains 22 Block and 3 Vital Spark
Infested Prism.pattern: Fixed four-move cycle Jab → Radiate → Whirlwind → Pulsate, repeating. Vital Spark stacks from Pulsate, raising the Tainted amount carried by every Skill. Solo encounter.

moves: Liquify Ground — applies 4 Sandpit to each player and shuffles 6 Frantic Escape into your deck, 3 into the draw pile and 3 into the discard pile (Sandpit is a duration debuff: 'In X turns, you will be eaten and die'; Frantic Escape is a 1-cost Colorless Status card: 'Increase Sandpit by 1. Increase the cost of this card by 1.')
a9_moves: Liquify Ground — applies 4 Sandpit to each player and shuffles 6 Frantic Escape into your deck, 3 into the draw pile and 3 into the discard pile (Sandpit is a duration debuff: 'In X turns, you will be eaten and die'; Frantic Escape is a 1-cost Colorless Status card: 'Increase Sandpit by 1. Increase the cost of this card by 1.')
The Insatiable.pattern: Always opens with Liquify Ground, then repeats the four-move cycle Thrash → Lunging Bite → Salivate → Thrash, looping back to the first Thrash. Liquify Ground is used on turn 1 only.

moves: Curse of Knowledge — each player chooses one of two debuffs to receive; the options change each time this move is used. 1st use: Disintegration 6 (at the end of your turn, take 6 damage) or Mind Rot 1 (draw 1 fewer card each turn). 2nd use: Disintegration 7 or Sloth 3 (you cannot play more than 3 cards each turn). 3rd use: Disintegration 8 or Waste Away 1 (gain 1 less Energy per turn)
Ponder — 11 dmg, heals 30 HP per player, gains 2 Strength
a9_moves: Curse of Knowledge — each player chooses one of two debuffs to receive; the options change each time this move is used. 1st use: Disintegration 6 (at the end of your turn, take 6 damage) or Mind Rot 1 (draw 1 fewer card each turn). 2nd use: Disintegration 7 or Sloth 3 (you cannot play more than 3 cards each turn). 3rd use: Disintegration 8 or Waste Away 1 (gain 1 less Energy per turn)
Ponder — 13 dmg, heals 30 HP per player, gains 3 Strength
Knowledge Demon.pattern: Cycles Curse of Knowledge → Slap → Knowledge Overwhelming → Ponder. Curse of Knowledge is used three times in total, one option pair per use; after the third, Curse of Knowledge is dropped from the cycle and the remaining three moves repeat in order.

powers: Back Attack — deals 50% more damage when it is attacking you from behind
Crab Rage — when an ally dies, it gains 6 Strength and 99 Block
moves: Bug Sting — 6 dmg × 2 + applies 2 Weak and 2 Frail
a9_moves: Bug Sting — 7 dmg × 2 + applies 2 Weak and 2 Frail
Crusher.pattern: One of the two bodies of the Kaiser Crab boss (the left claw), fought alongside Rocket. Cycles its five moves in fixed order, repeating forever: Thrash → Enlarging Strike → Bug Sting → Adapt → Guarded Strike. The player is surrounded by the two claws and faces only one at a time; whichever claw the player is facing away from gains the Back Attack bonus. When a single-target Attack is automatically played against a random target, the player turns to face whichever claw was targeted.

powers: Back Attack — deals 50% more damage when it is attacking you from behind
Crab Rage — when an ally dies, it gains 6 Strength and 99 Block
Rocket.pattern: One of the two bodies of the Kaiser Crab boss (the right claw), fought alongside Crusher. Cycles its five moves in fixed order, repeating forever: Targeting Reticle → Precision Beam → Charge Up → Laser → Recharge. The player is surrounded by the two claws and faces only one at a time; whichever claw the player is facing away from gains the Back Attack bonus. When a single-target Attack is automatically played against a random target, the player turns to face whichever claw was targeted.
